info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Airline Flights Checkin-v2-spec
info.description: The Flight Check-in Management API enables travelers to efficiently check in for their airline flights. This endpoint allows users to submit check-in requests and manage their boarding details seamlessly. It is particularly useful for airlines and travel service providers aiming to enhance customer experience during the pre-flight process. By streamlining the check-in operations, this API reduces wait times and improves overall passenger satisfaction.

post.description: This endpoint allows passengers to check in for their scheduled flights. It processes the check-in request and provides confirmation, allowing passengers to confirm their attendance for the flight.

requestBody.description: The request body contains information required to check in a flight. This typically includes passenger details, flight number, and any additional services requested. Ensure that all necessary fields are provided to successfully complete the check-in process.

200.description: Check-in completed successfully, returning flight details.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the check-in request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the check-in process.

customer.description: Details of the customer checking in.

resource.description: The resource being checked in, such as a flight or a baggage.

priority.description: Priority level of the check-in, where higher values denote higher priority.

amount.description: The amount associated with the check-in operation.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required after the check-in is completed.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the check-in was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the check-in was initiated (e.g., web, mobile).

recordIndex.description: Index for record keeping, useful for identifying specific requests.

CreateAirlineFlightsCheckinRequest.description: Request body for initiating a check-in operation.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates whether the customer is a VIP.

Customer.description: Information regarding the customer involved in the check-in process.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the check-in request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the check-in operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the check-in operation in milliseconds.
